text: The Norwegian Nobel Committee awards the 2026 Peace Prize to Navanethem Pillay, former ICC judge and UN High Commissioner for Human Rights. Her judicial record spans international prosecution of war crimes, crimes against humanity, and genocide.

meta.note: The award recognizes an established legal record; committee statements are not treated as independent validation of outcomes.

text: Delta lowers 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.10-$5.60 and free cash flow to $2.5 billion. Jet fuel reaches $4.34 per gallon. Q3 net income falls 47% despite 21% operating revenue growth. Premium revenue rises 18%, with higher fares and sustained bookings.

meta.note: Revised guidance and reported earnings are distinct measures; demand strength is based on management statements.

text: Treasury appoints Judy Shelton as counselor to Secretary Scott Bessent on currency policy and China's financial conditions. Her 2019 Federal Reserve Board nomination was rejected by the Senate. The Treasury advisory position does not require Senate confirmation.

meta.note: The appointment establishes an advisory role, not Federal Reserve authority or monetary policy control.

text: Trump establishes a three-member executive committee to examine mortgage-related allegations against Fed Governor Lisa Cook. A Nov. 5 hearing is scheduled. Cook remains in office under judicial protection, while the committee reviews potential grounds for removal.

meta.note: Allegations remain disputed; the committee's legal validity and any grounds for removal are unresolved.

text: Trump announces a U.S.-Russia diesel supply agreement exceeding 4 million tons. Treasury authorizes Russian diesel transactions through April 2027 under a temporary sanctions waiver. Initial deliveries total 300,000 tons, with additional volumes subject to refinery availability.

meta.note: Supply volumes are announced commitments, not verified deliveries; later quantities remain conditional.

text: T-Mobile shares fall 13.27%, AT&T 9.81%, and Verizon 8.75%, marking multidecade daily declines. SpaceX rises approximately 1%. Its agreement to acquire up to 14 MHz of paired 800 MHz spectrum remains subject to FCC approval.

meta.note: Equity movements are observed; competitive displacement and network deployment remain unconfirmed.
